verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a public Billing API with Bearer API-key auth, granular permissions, key rotation, and rate limits. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec in a GitHub repo, a Postman collection covering every operation, four official server SDKs, and a sandbox with the same APIs. A hosted MCP server whose codemode `search`/`execute` tools cover the full API adds an agent-first path. The probe 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is documented as living in the PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API (only the llms.txt probe confirms the docs exist), and no OpenAPI spec served at a standard discoverable URL on the docs site.
